changes.evidence: The Punisher S2, episode 6 ('Nakazat'): Poloznev tells Frank the Schultzes own Testament Industries ('Testament Industries. Factories, oil and chemicals, and farming...'). Anderson and Eliza founded and run the company; it is their organization (employer rule). No departure before they die in the season finale.

Daredevil S1: Owlsley is a financial advisor at the accounting firm Silver & Brent, named on screen in episode 7 ('Stick': 'I work for Silver & Brent') and episode 10 (Marci: 'Fisk is one of our most billable clients, along with Owlsley at Silver & Brent'). He turns on Fisk (a real departure from Fisk's Empire) but never leaves the firm: in episode 13 Foggy and Matt discuss him using Silver & Brent 'company funds' to stash Hoffman. So after turning on Fisk he is back to his employer, not in no group. If the owner prefers the minimal fix, keep the Independent/left and only add the Silver & Brent stage first.

Madame Web: Cassie works as an FDNY paramedic with partners Ben Parker and O'Neil (FDNY EMS ambulance and uniforms on screen); she never quits on screen, she is left blind and paralyzed at the end. Employer counts as a group; the dataset already uses 'FDNY'. (The same applies to A:sv-ben-parker-madame-web and A:sv-oneil-madame-web, outside this chunk.)

Runaways S2 (episodes 17-20 of the show): AWOL is in Flores's LAPD strike team on PRIDE's payroll. In episode 19 ('Big Shot') he goes to PRIDE, offers to remove Flores and head the strike team for them, PRIDE agrees, and he kills Flores and abducts Livvie 'continuing his work for PRIDE'; in episode 20 he vanishes while still on that job. Nothing moves him out of PRIDE's service, so the final return-to-LAPD stage records a move that never happens.

owner_calls.question: Hammerhead has no group, but he is the Big Man's (Tombstone's) enforcer through the show until Tombstone fires him at the Valentine's Day summit (episode 23, 'Gangland'). The dataset has no name for the Big Man's SSM organization (Tombstone SSM is not on file) and the show does not name it. Add a stage, and under what name?
options: Add [[<name for the Big Man's organization>, '(from the start)'], ['Independent', 'The Spectacular Spider-Man']] with left 'The Spectacular Spider-Man' (fired by Tombstone in episode 23)
